title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use in their social network and update their adoption probability based on normative and informational influence.

interactions.name: location_based_influence_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Mask-wearing is influenced by observed norms at a location and enforced by location policies, potentially including entry denial or fines.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media and social channels broadcast messages that shift beliefs about mask effectiveness and risk; misinformation can reduce adoption.

interactions.name: policy_intervention
interactions.description: Authorities implement recommendations or mandates, adjust enforcement and fines, and run campaigns that alter adoption incentives.

interactions.name: supply_distribution
interactions.description: Mask supply is produced and distributed; availability and price affect the ability and willingness of people to adopt mask usage.

interactions.name: disease_transmission_modulated_by_masks
interactions.description: If disease dynamics are enabled, masks reduce transmission probability during contacts at locations.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of interactions or individuals wearing masks on a given day and averaged over the simulation.

metrics.name: consistent_wearers_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population classified as consistent mask users over a rolling window.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate within each location type (e.g., transit, workplace, retail).

metrics.name: compliance_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rate specifically in locations with mask mandates.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate pre- vs post-policy (e.g., difference-in-means over specified windows).

metrics.name: supply_demand_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of available masks to requested purchases per day and over time.

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between defined subgroups (e.g., low vs high income).

metrics.name: misinformation_exposure_rate
metrics.description: Average exposure to misinformation content per person per day.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total infections over the time horizon (if disease model enabled).

metrics.name: cases_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections between mask-enabled and counterfactual no-mask scenarios.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_rate_bounds
validation_criteria.description: At all times, adoption metrics must remain within [0, 1].

validation_criteria.name: no_negative_stock
validation_criteria.description: MaskSupplier stock must remain non-negative throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: stability_check
validation_criteria.description: Optional convergence rule: the 7-day moving average of overall adoption changes by less than 0.5 percentage points for the final 14 days.
